title: Asahina Mafuyu — Profile Story

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm not sure if we're ever going to introduce ourselves as members of N25 in the future...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But if it'll help take my mind off things, then okay...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <My username is Yuki, and I mainly write lyrics for Nightcord at 25:00.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It's nice to meet you, and I hope you'll continue listening to our music.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Amia, Enanan, please lower your volume. I can hear you both just fine.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<That's not enough...?
What else do you want me to say?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Something good that happened to me recently...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <We get to work together like this again.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I still don't know what I should do next...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But... I'd like to stay here for the time being.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I think I've made my feelings clear...>
